blocks.x: Connected machines to connected margin — service revenue attach up 3x

A construction-equipment manufacturer: a Manufacturing & Industrial program run on the outcome-linked model with a blended Dataq Software team. The name stays behind the NDA; the numbers are published with permission.
Installed base unconnected; service reactive; contract pricing on tradition.
Warranty leakage unexplained; failure knowledge anecdotal. EU CRA product-security duties landing on unmanaged firmware estates.

The machine fleet platform brought provisioning, OTA and telemetry to the installed base; service economics (cost per machine, contract profitability) were instrumented on Forge; dispatch orchestration lifted first-time-fix; and the product-security program (SBOM, signed firmware, vulnerability SLAs) turned CRA duties into evidence.

items: the twin drifted when the asset drifted — and the sync loop caught it, which is what kept operators using it.
one governed definition per metric ended the metric disputes before the build scaled.
every automated action carried its policy version and its trail, which is why operations trusted the fleet by month three.

blocks.x: The transferable asset from the construction-equipment manufacturer program is the measurement design: baseline definitions, gate criteria, evidence cadence.
